pages.text: Tier 2 bosses live in the Twilight Forest, Blue Skies, and The Aether. This is where Simply Swords uniques begin. Prepare in full steel or manasteel before attempting Twilight Forest.

$(bold)Naga$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Tempest$(/l), Naga Scale.$(br2)$(bold)Lich$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulrender$(/l), Lich Soul.$(br2)$(bold)Hydra$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Emberblade$(/l), Hydra Fang.$(br2)$(bold)Ur-Ghast$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Whisperwind$(/l) (20% — highest T2 rate), Ur-Ghast Tear.

$(bold)Knight Phantom$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Enigma$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Snow Queen$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Frostfall$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Alpha Yeti$(/bold) (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Icewhisper$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies Bosses$(/bold) — Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, Arachnarch. Each drops a unique.$(br2)$(bold)Aether Bosses$(/bold) — Slider, Valkyrie Queen, Sun Spirit. Each drops a unique.
